title: Cosco
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~3 years) | FHV+
Never been around dogs
Cosco was brought in as a stray in early 2024. She was pregnant and eventually gave birth at the shelter. All of her kittens were adopted but unfortunately she is still here. She is one of our longest stays currently at the shelter. She is a total sweetheart and loves human interaction. 
She is FHV+ and would need to be an only cat. FHV isn’t as daunting as it sounds. There is no medication for FHV therefore her vet bills would be the same as any other cat! 
Cosco has a cloudy eye and it’s from a scratch that healed. There’s no issue with it!

title: Sophie
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~3-5 years) | FIV+
Preferably only cat. Indoor only. Never been around dogs.
Sophie came in as a stray in January 2025. She is the perfect mix of sweet and sassy. She loves pets but will let you know when she wants her space. She has warmed up to having neighboring cats but would probably do best as the only cat. She is FIV+ so she would need to be indoors only. She has not shown any physical symptoms/health issues from the FIV. It was only discovered through routine testing.

title: Domino
description:
Male | Born late 2024/early 2025
Never been around dogs
The WHHS took in Domino from the reservation in April 2025. Since he came in, he’s been very reserved and keeps to himself. But 2026 might be his year - he’s started to come out of his shell and make his presence known! He’ll gladly take pets and would do better in a calmer home without many animals or kids. He’ll accept pets and when he’s decided he’s finished, he’ll either walk away but sometimes gets salty with a swat, but hey, he’s a cat…

title: Twilight
description:
Female | 1+ year
Never been around dogs
Twilight was born at the shelter on May 1, 2025. She is the last of her 4 siblings still at the shelter. She is a very relaxed and gentle girl but is getting more and more outgoing (coming up to greet visitors) every day. She is in the cattery and likes to snuggle with the other cats. She’ll gladly take any pets that come her way.

title: Ellie
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~3 years)
Never been around dogs
Ellie came in as a stray in June 2025. Since then she has really opened up. She is quite curious and likes to explore. Ellie loves getting attention and pets as well - she’s absolutely gorgeous and we aren’t sure why she is still with us. Consider adding this beauty to your family!

title: Tabby
description:
Female | ~1-2 years
Never been around dogs
Tabby came to us as a stray in August 2025. She has become more social and affectionate recently and we are so happy to see her happy! But, she would sure be happier in a loving home and out of the kennel. We hope you come and fall in love with this gorgeous gal!

title: Finn
description:
Male | Undetermined age (~2 years)
Never been around dogs
Finn came in as a stray in October 2025. Since his first day here, he has been extremely sweet. He is in our cattery with other cats and does well. You’ll often find him snuggled up in a bed but will get up to come greet you.

title: Esmeralda
description:
Female | Born 9/10/2015
No young children, preferably no other pets
Esmeralda and her grey Tortie sister, Eleanor, were brought to us on April 4th, 2026. Their parents were expecting a baby and these cats are not fans of children (many attempts were made to get to know kiddos in the family) so they came to us. Esmeralda does lick when she’s stressed so she has some bald patches or spots with thin hair - she’s still a beauty though! Esmeralda would love to join an adult or two in a quiet home. The sisters don’t get along that well and if adopted together, would likely keep their distance in their new home. 
Esmeralda will come with her automatic feeder when adopted.
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Prego
description:
Female | Undetermined age (~5 years)
No dogs, preferably no cats
Hailey’s favorite kitty! Prego came to us as a pregnant stray in January 2026. She gave birth to 4 healthy babies and they have all been adopted. Like her, they were all named after sauces! Prego is an extremely affectionate cat with a bobtail that enjoys watching out the window, growling at anything out of the ordinary - she’d make a great guard dog! Prego loves to be pet, enjoys lounging around, and is always eager to say “hello!” She is currently in the cattery in her own kennel, where she has more room to roam and to be around other cats and we are curious if she’ll warm up to other kitties now that she doesn’t have kittens. Prego enjoys giving humans kisses!

title: Canyon
description:
Female | Born 2024
Never been around dogs
Canyon came to us with 5 other cats in April 2026. Her owner was unable to care for them and it took awhile for us to gain ownership of them. We’ve gotten to know them over the last few months and they are all so sweet and FINALLY ready to go to a new home! Canyon has big beautiful eyes and is a bit more timid. But like her “sisters” she warms up to people and is a sweetheart once she’s comfortable.

title: Cascade
description:
Female | Born 2025
Never been around dogs
Cascade came to us in July 2026 with 4 babies. She is a just a baby herself, definitely not a year old. She’s got that grumpy face but she is a sweet pea, just a little shy. A quiet home would be best for this gal. She does warm up to other cats, especially older ones and she isn’t too upset by the presence of small dogs.

title: Birkenstock
description:
Female | Born 2025
Never been around dogs
Birkenstock came to us in July 2026 with her two kittens, Chaco & Keen. She’s just a baby herself and was very skinny. She took care of her babies and is eager to start a life with a new family, where she can be the young cat she is. She’s a slender beauty!

title: Faith Hill
description:
Female | 3-4 months
Never been around dogs
Faith Hill came to us with her country music siblings on 8/13/26. They are all a little reserved but once you start petting them, they are your new best friend!

title: Finley
description:
Male | est DOB ~2021
Never been around dogs.
Finley came to us in August 2026 as a known stray. He’s very vocal and affectionate and we can’t wait for him to find his forever home!

title: Mama (needs a) Martini
description:
Female | Born 2026
Never been around dogs.
Arrived August 2026 with kittens of her own. She is a kitten herself and did her best to avoid her kittens…another mom took them in - whew! She is very vocal and sweet. She loves the freedom of the cattery and is a wonderful greeter.

title: Rover
description:
Male | Born 2020
Unsure how he is with dogs, probably best as only pet.
Rover came to us 8/29/26 after he was used to be an indoor/outdoor cat and after moving, had to stay inside. He started marking inside and the former owners decided to seek our assistance in rehoming him. We are hopeful he just needs a fresh start and we’ve had great luck with cats with the same issues - once they get into a new home, these patterns have stopped. He’s affectionate and likes to cuddle, but does not like to be picked up. He is not a fan of some cats and not a fan of other animals. Based on the marking, that’s something that is common around children so a home with older children or adults would be recommended. He is getting along with his senior lady roommates and no marking had occurred with us yet!

title: Magi Lune
description:
Female | Born 2026
Not yet available - working on socializing + vaccinations 
Never been around dogs.
Magi Lune came to us in August 2026 as a stray - a few others came in with her and are all named after Fern Gully characters. She’s a bit wiley but we are hoping she warms up! Her kiddos, Crysta and Hexxus are also with us. She’s a young mom, definitely under a year old. Stay tuned on her progress!

title: Crysta
description:
Female | Kitten
Never been around dogs.
Crysta came to us in August 2026 as a stray of about 3 months old - a few others came in with her and are all named after Fern Gully characters. She’s a bit shy but is really warming up to pets and affection and coming out of her hiding spot. Her sister and mom, Hexxus and Magi Lune are also with us.

title: Loki
description:
Male | Born ~4/2023
No other cats, never been around children or dogs
Loki came to us Sept. 26, 2026 after his owner could no longer care for him. He’s a bit scared in his new space but he’s a sweetheart that loves to be comforted with pets. 
Seniors are $25 to adopt or ask about our Senior for Senior program!

title: Sequioa
description:
Female | Kitten
Currently being fostered (NOT in shelter) 
She is such a beauty!! She would love to have a friend to play and wrestle with and she adores her foster family! She is a love bug!!! Once you are approved we will put you touch with our foster! These kiddos are spayed/neutered and up to date on their vaccines. They are looking for indoor only homes and would really love to be adopted with a sibling or at least into a home with another young kitty looking for a friend! They LOVE each other! They are used to other cats and love the foster's small dog.

title: Angelica Pickles
description:
Female | Born April 2026 
The Rugrats came to us in Sept. 2026 after the health decline of their owner. There were lots of kitties in her possession and 9 came to us - The Rugrats! They are 2 different litters. 
Angelica Pickles is a mellow sweetie. She loves to cuddle with her siblings so a home with another younger cat would be ideal for this cutie.

title: Cynthia
description:
Female | Born April 2026 
The Rugrats came to us in Sept. 2026 after the health decline of their owner. There were lots of kitties in her possession and 9 came to us - The Rugrats! They are 2 different litters. 
Cynthia is THE SWEETEST KITTEN! Oh my goodness, she loves to share her love and is full of purrs. She needs someone that will give her all the love and is ready to receive more love than they’ve gotten from another cat. Cynthia would love a home with another kitty needing a snuggle buddy and playmate.

title: Chuckie Finster
description:
Male | Born 8/1/26
The Rugrats came to us in Sept. 2026 after the health decline of their owner. There were lots of kitties in her possession and 9 came to us - The Rugrats! They are 2 different litters.

description:
Female | Born April 2026

Susie is very playful. She would do best in a home with another kitty as she needs a good playmate.

title: Lil DeVille
description:

Lil is a little shy but gets jealous quickly when she isn’t getting pets and her siblings are - it’s pretty cute. She would do best in a home with another kitty as it helps her come out of her shell.

title: Dolly
description:
Female | Kitten
Available TBA Oct/Nov
Dolly came to us as a tiny stray shortly after Dolly Parton’s passing. She’s playful, sassy, and ready to move in to a home where she can run around, pounce, and hunt toys. Dolly would benefit from another kitten or a younger energetic cat to pal around with.

title: David Bowie
description:
Male | Kitten
Available 10/8 following neuter appt
David Bowie is a sweet, chill but playful, lover boy! He loves kisses on the face and is very sweet with his little “brother.” He’s a handsome boy that would love to play and cuddle with another kitty friend.

title: Michael Buble
description:
Male | Kitten
Available 10/8 following neuter appt
Michael Buble is very vocal and affectionate - He’s always singing his heart out and loves to purr. He loves to demand attention. He’s small but growing into quite the handsome guy! He’s playful but also lazy. His true kitten energy will probably show in his new home.

title: Sophie Grey
description:
Female | Born 2020
Sophie Grey came to us early Oct 2026 after one of her owners experienced declining health. Sophie Grey is super soft and sweet, but when she’s done receiving pets that means no more… She will bite being over-petted but is VERY sweet if you keep things mellow. We think Sophie Grey would do best in a home without kids and as the only pet. As we get to know her, maybe that will change!

This scared young one is petable but quite the escape artist too. We are going to be working with it to socialize since it appears more scared than anything.

title: Nova
description:
Female | Australian Shepherd Mix | 6 yrs
No kids, needs to be only pet
Nova is back from her foster adventure! We learned that she really will do best with only one human in the house and being the only pet. She still needs slow introductions even when in her new home. She had great manners without accidents in her foster home and was not destructive so she would not need to be kenneled when left home alone. Please ask questions and we’d be happy to get you in touch with her former foster dad if you want to get to know her more! 
Our longest term resident! Nova was brought in with a male dog and a puppy in 2022, though she remains. Being in the shelter for so long has made her reactive and sassy, therefore she requires a slow introduction. For most new introductions we muzzle her to keep everyone safe. She does have a bite history. Once she is comfortable with you, she is very affectionate. We call her “Our Princess.” 
She does not get along with female dogs but has shown little to no aggression towards male dogs. Give her some time, you’ll love her as much as we do! 
Nova weighs around 30 pounds.
Nova's adoption has been sponsored!

title: Lilac
description:
Female | Coohound Mix | Born 8/5/2022
No kids or elderly (will nip at), no cats, some dogs *would do best with single adult & no other pets
This pretty lady came to us on 4/7/2026. She is a great dog who is just a bit particular. She’s not a big fan of some people (some men, some elderly) and does not get along with all dogs in a household setting. Lilac has been to doggy daycare in Rapid City at Meadowridge Pet Lodge, and gets along with dogs in a neutral setting. She has some separation anxiety and can be a bit destructive when left home alone, though she hasn’t shown any destructive behavior spending nights with one of our employees. She is not a fan of small children. If you have further question regarding Lilac, please reach out through our email. 
Lilac weighs around 50 lbs. 
Lilac's adoption has been sponsored!

title: Cutlass
description:
Male | Heeler/Doberman Mix | Born 3/8/23
Seeking training before adoption
No cats, no male dogs, no kids
Cutlass came to us on 4/30/26 after his owner passed away. We think he would do best with older kids, a fenced yard, and/or living with someone who is very active. Cutlass has a lot of energy to burn and absolutely loves the water! He’s a lake or creek playing dog for sure. Cutlass is a little finicky upon new introductions & he does have a bite history, he’s quite tough with a kennel between you and he, but once he warms up, he’s a real hambone. We invite you to come visit him and see if you could be his next best friend!
Cutlass weighs 50 lbs.

title: Harlequinn
description:
Female | Lab/Pit Mix | Born 3/20/24
Some other dogs (does better outside of shelter), unsure of cats
Harlequinn is with us after not being able to return home. Harley is a sweet but reserved gal. She’ll give you a full body dog kiss bath! Although she got along with sister Akasha, doesn’t seem to be a big fan of other dogs and would probably chase cats if given the chance. Harley is a lover of people and jumps up on you when she’s excited! She is a sweet cuddler and loves to go on car rides! Harley has a hematoma on her neck from her former chain collar and requires harnessing (no medical concern).
Harlequinn weighs 48 pounds

title: Charlie
description:
Male | Retriever/Black Lab Mix | Born Jan. 2022
Charlie came to us on 8/15/26 after the health decline of his owner - life happens and luckily we were here to help out a family having to make this hard choice. Charlie is a sweet boy, a little chunky, and a HUGE fan of belly rubs. He’s a very sweet boy that would love to find his next human/family. He needs training and is very food motivated. Charlie is 88 lbs.

title: Athena
description:
Female | Retriever/Labrador Mix | Born April 2020
Athena came to us on 8/18/26 after the health decline of her owner. She is “sister” to Charlie who came to us a few days earlier. Life happens and we are happy to help this sweet girl find her new home. Athena needs training and is very food motivated. Athena is 66 lbs.
Athena is a senior & available for a senior fee of $75.

title: Sunny
description:
Female | Staffordshire Bull Terrier/American Pitbull/Lab Mix | Born ~2019-2020
Seeking training before adoption
Sunny is back with us after spending 7 months with a family. She was returned after biting her grandma. She first came to us after coming in as a stray in July of 2025. Sunny is weary of men and she should not be around children. She is a sweet goofball who loves water… she just needs pateince and hopefully training will help us understand her and her needs better. Sunny is 55 lbs. 
Sunny’s adoption fee is $75 since she's been a long term resident and is approaching her senior years.

title: Charley
description:
Female | Chocolate Lab/Pit Mix | Born Nov. 2025
No cats
Charley came to us on Sept. 24, 2026 after she was getting too rambunctious with her family’s kittens and small children. She is not aggressive but just a little too energetic for delicate things! She needs some training but is a total doll. She is said to do well with other dogs. Charley is 53 lbs.
